p: chosen men of Israel with him: That is, of the most skilful and valiant soldiers.
Hittite: Who was a stranger, and not an Israelite.
Joab: Who afterward was David's chief captain.
second time: Meaning, he would make him sure at one stroke.
against the LORD'S anointed: That is, in his own private cause: for Jehu slew two kings at God's appointment, 2Ki 9:24.
man: Esteemed most valiant and fit to save the king?
my son David: By this it appears, that the hypocrite persecuted David against his own conscience and contrary to his promise.
accept an offering: Let his anger toward us be pacified by a sacrifice.
other gods: As much as lay in them, they compelled him to idolatry because they forced him to flee to the idolaters.
precious in thine eyes this day: Because you saved my life this day.
righteousness and his faithfulness: Thus he protests his innocency toward Saul, not defending his justice in the sight of God, in whose presence none is righteous, Ps 14:3,130:3.
